description: Source-backed authoring, baking, and runtime contract for FOnline map containers.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned engine revision. Project map catalogs, custom metadata, gameplay semantics, and composition policy remain project-owned.
included: one or more ProtoMap anchors with nested map-addressed Critter and Item sections
map identity, placement ids, prototype references, ownership, and property overrides
mapper normalization, side-specific baking, and runtime materialization
engine-owned Map, Critter, and Item property catalogs
excluded: project-authored properties, prototype ids, map catalogs, and directory taxonomy
quest, encounter, balance, visual-kit, and level-design policy
runtime save records and dynamic entities created after map materialization
pathfinding, combat geometry, lighting design, and renderer-specific composition guidance

outputs.source_selection: Baking.ProtoFileExtensions plus at least one [ProtoMap] anchor
outputs.description: MapBaker emits one coupled server/client resource pair for every map declared by a ProtoMap anchor.

sections.name: Map prototype
sections.description: Declares map-level properties and starts the context used by following [$Name/Critter] and [$Name/Item] sections.

anchors: Invalid map format, no ProtoMap anchor declared

sections.name: Critter placement
sections.cardinality: zero or more per declared map
sections.description: Places a critter prototype and applies per-placement Critter property overrides.

sections.name: Item placement
sections.cardinality: zero or more per declared map
sections.description: Places a map, inventory, or container item and applies per-placement Item property overrides.

directives.name: $Name
directives.description: Selects the Map prototype id and both baked resource basenames. Without $Name the anchor resolves to the source basename; multi-map containers should name every anchor explicitly.

directives.name: $Parent
directives.description: Uses ordinary Map prototype inheritance during prototype baking. Mapper save output is flattened and does not preserve this directive.

directives.name: $Text <language>
directives.description: Contributes localized prototype text and is preserved as an extra ProtoMap field by mapper load/save.

anchors: Proto text key must start with $Text

directives.name: $Id
directives.description: Provides a shared placement identity used by ownership references. Missing, non-positive, or duplicate ids are repaired during load; authored maps should not rely on repair.

directives.name: $Proto
directives.description: Resolves the base Critter or Item prototype before placement overrides are applied.

ownerships.name: MapHex
ownerships.description: Places the item on a map hex. Static items must use this mode.

anchors: Item is not placed on map hex

ownerships.name: CritterInventory
ownerships.description: Creates a non-static item in the inventory of the placed critter identified by CritterId.

ownerships.name: ItemContainer
ownerships.description: Creates a non-static item inside the placed non-static item identified by ContainerId.

ownerships.name: Nowhere
ownerships.description: Exists in the enum but is not a supported authored map-placement mode.

anchors: Map item load produced item with unsupported ownership

rules.name: Configuration syntax
rules.requirement: Use INI-like repeated sections, key = value assignments, # comments, backslash continuation, and key += value append where the property parser supports it.

rules.name: Closed section set
rules.requirement: Use top-level ProtoMap anchors and nested <owner>/Critter or <owner>/Item sections only.
rules.description: [$Name/...] binds to the preceding anchor. An explicit owner must name a declared map; a contextual nested section before the first anchor is rejected.

anchors: expected a ProtoMap anchor or nested map content
Nested map section appears before any ProtoMap anchor

rules.name: Map identity
rules.requirement: Give every map in a multi-map container a unique ProtoMap $Name; a single unnamed anchor inherits the source basename.
rules.description: Map identity, targeted bake lookup, and baked output names come from declared map ids, not container filenames.

rules.name: Shared placement ids
rules.requirement: Use explicit positive ids unique across all Critter and Item sections in one map.
rules.description: The loader repairs omitted, non-positive, and duplicate ids, but repaired values can invalidate hand-authored owner references.

rules.name: Prototype resolution
rules.requirement: Every Critter and Item section must name an existing prototype with $Proto.
rules.description: Missing and unresolved prototypes are accumulated as map-load errors.

rules.name: Property overrides
rules.requirement: Use properties valid for the section receiver and bake side; values override the resolved base prototype.
rules.description: MapBaker copies the prototype properties, applies section text, validates resources, and serializes side-specific data.

rules.name: Normalized entity order
rules.requirement: Do not use textual interleaving as an ordering contract.
rules.description: The loader processes all Critter sections before all Item sections, and mapper save emits critters with inventory items before map items with direct children.

rules.name: Ownership references
rules.requirement: CritterInventory and ItemContainer placements must reference a materializable owner id through CritterId or ContainerId.
rules.description: Unmapped owner ids skip child creation; direct children of placed critters and non-static map items are the supported mapper/runtime shape.

rules.name: Static item placement
rules.requirement: A Static item must use MapHex ownership.
rules.description: Static items become immutable map-grid entries and contribute movement, shooting, trigger, and multihex state.

rules.name: Map bounds
rules.requirement: Critter Hex and MapHex item Hex values must be inside ProtoMap Size before runtime loading.
rules.description: Server load rejects invalid positions. Mapper editing commands may clamp positions, which is not a substitute for source validation.

rules.name: Side-specific bake
rules.requirement: Treat server and client map binaries as a coupled output and regenerate both after source or referenced prototype changes.
rules.description: The server receives critters and all items; the client receives visible static items and its required string hashes.

rules.name: Hidden static items
rules.requirement: Do not expect a Hidden static item entity in the client map payload.
rules.description: Its client-side property strings are still hashed, but the item record is omitted.

anchors: For hidden items keep only string hashes for client

rules.name: Runtime materialization
rules.requirement: Use Static only for immutable map-hex fixtures; use non-static placements for generated critters, map items, inventories, and containers.
rules.description: The server remaps authored ids for generated critters and non-static map items before attaching direct child items.

rules.name: Mapper round-trip
rules.requirement: Review mapper-saved diffs as normalized output, not byte-preserving serialization.
rules.description: The mapper emits $Name and normalized [$Name/...] sections for the edited map, retains $Text fields, flattens inherited map properties, and preserves sibling map blocks byte-exact in a multi-map container.

anchors: Other maps in the file are preserved byte-exact

rules.name: Multihex mesh serialization
rules.requirement: MultihexMesh must contain x/y coordinate pairs; mapper save normalizes it into backslash-continued pairs.
rules.description: An odd coordinate count fails mapper serialization.

anchors: Mapper item MultihexMesh field must contain x/y coordinate pairs

rules.name: Runtime multihex-line footprint
rules.requirement: Treat MultihexLines as part of an item's complete runtime footprint around both its anchor and every valid MultihexMesh cell.
rules.description: Server static and dynamic materialization index every expanded line cell to the same item and recache its blocking and interaction flags.

rules.name: Error aggregation
rules.requirement: Treat any accumulated entity load or property/resource validation error as a failed map bake.
rules.description: Entity diagnostics are logged individually before MapLoader or MapBaker throws the aggregate failure.

properties.name: AttachMaster
properties.description: Identifier of the attachment master; zero when the critter is not attached.

properties.name: Condition
properties.description: Current life-state condition used by animation, filtering, and gameplay queries.

properties.name: ControlledByPlayer
properties.description: Classifies the critter as player-controllable independently of its current online state.

properties.name: CustomHolderEntry
properties.description: For a custom entity, names the holder entry through which it is attached.

properties.name: CustomHolderId
properties.description: For a custom entity, stores the persistent identifier of its owning holder; zero when the holder has no persistent identifier.

properties.name: DeadDrawNoFlatten
properties.description: Keeps a dead critter in the normal critter draw order instead of the flattened dead-critter order.

properties.name: Dir
properties.description: Current facing direction on the map grid.

properties.name: Elevation
properties.description: Vertical rendering elevation of the critter.

properties.name: ExplicitlyPersistent
properties.description: Marks an entity as independently persistent rather than persistent only through containment by another entity.

properties.name: GlobalMapTripId
properties.description: Server-assigned identifier shared by members of the same current global-map trip.

properties.name: Hex
properties.description: Origin hex currently occupied by the critter on its map.

properties.name: HexOffset
properties.description: Sub-hex map-space offset used by movement interpolation and rendering.

properties.name: HideSprite
properties.description: Hides the current client map sprite without removing the critter's map presence.

properties.name: InitScript
properties.description: Server initialization function called after the critter-init event for a newly created or restored critter.

properties.name: IsAttached
properties.description: Reports that this critter currently follows another critter as an attachment.

properties.name: IsChosen
properties.description: Reports that this critter is the locally chosen critter on the current client.

properties.name: IsPlayerOffline
properties.description: Client-side connection state reported for a player-controlled critter.

properties.name: ItemIds
properties.description: Persistent identifiers of the items directly held in the critter's inventory.

properties.name: LightColor
properties.description: RGBA color emitted by the critter's client-side light source.

properties.name: LightDistance
properties.description: Radius in hexes reached by the critter's client-side light source.

properties.name: LightFlags
properties.description: Bit mask controlling global, inverse, and direction-blocking behavior of the light source.

properties.name: LightIntensity
properties.description: Signed percentage intensity of the critter's client-side light source.

properties.name: LightSource
properties.description: Enables a client-side map light source centered on this critter.

properties.name: LookDistance
properties.description: Maximum map-view distance in hexes used by server visibility processing.

properties.name: MapId
properties.description: Identifier of the map currently containing the critter; zero while it is on the global map.

properties.name: ModelLayers
properties.description: Fixed-size client values passed to the 3D model layer and animation resolver.

properties.name: ModelName
properties.description: Sprite or 3D model resource used to present the critter.

properties.name: MovingSpeed
properties.description: Current server movement speed published for active movement.

properties.name: Multihex
properties.description: Radius in hexes occupied by the critter in movement, pathfinding, and distance checks.

properties.name: NameOffset
properties.description: Vertical pixel adjustment applied to the critter name label.

properties.name: ScaleFactor
properties.description: 3D model scale in thousandths; zero selects the default scale of 1000.

properties.name: ShowCritterDist1
properties.description: Optional first visibility-event distance in hexes; zero disables this distance group.

properties.name: ShowCritterDist2
properties.description: Optional second visibility-event distance in hexes; zero disables this distance group.

properties.name: ShowCritterDist3
properties.description: Optional third visibility-event distance in hexes; zero disables this distance group.

properties.name: VisibilityMode
properties.description: Visibility detail mode assigned to this critter from the current client's viewpoint.

properties.name: AlwaysHideSprite
properties.description: Prevents the item sprite from being drawn at runtime and hides it by default in Mapper.

properties.name: Colorize
properties.description: Enables ColorizeColor tinting for the item's map sprite.

properties.name: ColorizeColor
properties.description: RGBA tint applied when Colorize is enabled; alpha also supplies the default sprite opacity.

properties.name: ContainerId
properties.description: Identifier of the parent item while Ownership is ItemContainer; zero otherwise.

properties.name: ContainerStack
properties.description: Project-defined grouping key used to select and merge items inside a container.

properties.name: Corner
properties.description: Wall-corner orientation used by map lighting and transparent-foreground behavior.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Positive quantity represented by this item; non-stackable items must have a value of one.

properties.name: CritterId
properties.description: Identifier of the owning critter while Ownership is CritterInventory; zero otherwise.

properties.name: CritterSlot
properties.description: Inventory or equipment slot occupied while the item belongs to a critter.

properties.name: CustomHolderEntry
properties.description: For a custom entity, names the holder entry through which it is attached.

properties.name: CustomHolderId
properties.description: For a custom entity, stores the persistent identifier of its owning holder; zero when the holder has no persistent identifier.

properties.name: DisableEgg
properties.description: Disables transparent-foreground egg processing for the item's map sprite.

properties.name: DrawFlatten
properties.description: Renders the item in a flat map pass instead of the normal depth-sorted item pass.

properties.name: DrawMultihexLines
properties.description: Draws repeated item sprites on footprint hexes generated by MultihexLines.

properties.name: DrawMultihexMesh
properties.description: Draws repeated item sprites on the explicit MultihexMesh hexes.

properties.name: DrawOrderOffsetHexY
properties.description: Signed Y-hex offset used only when calculating the item's sprite draw order.

properties.name: Elevation
properties.description: Vertical rendering elevation of the map item.

properties.name: ExplicitlyPersistent
properties.description: Marks an entity as independently persistent rather than persistent only through containment by another entity.

properties.name: Hex
properties.description: Origin map hex used while the item is placed on a map.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Server visibility flag that suppresses a dynamic item from client views while set.

properties.name: HideSprite
properties.description: Hides the current client map sprite without removing the item's map presence.

properties.name: InitScript
properties.description: Server initialization function called after the item-init event for a newly created or restored item.

properties.name: InnerItemIds
properties.description: Persistent identifiers of the items directly contained by this item.

properties.name: IsGag
properties.description: Marks a blocking item as conditionally passable through the map gag callback.

properties.name: IsRoofTile
properties.description: Selects roof rendering instead of ground-tile rendering when IsTile is enabled.

properties.name: IsScenery
properties.description: Classifies the item as scenery for Mapper filtering and flat-render lighting rules.

properties.name: IsTile
properties.description: Classifies the item as a ground or roof tile rendered in a tile layer.

properties.name: IsTrigger
properties.description: Includes the item in map trigger lookup and movement-trigger processing.

properties.name: IsWall
properties.description: Classifies the item as a wall for Mapper filtering and map presentation.

properties.name: LightColor
properties.description: RGBA color emitted by the item's light source.

properties.name: LightDistance
properties.description: Radius in hexes reached by the item's light source.

properties.name: LightFlags
properties.description: Bit mask controlling global, inverse, and direction-blocking behavior of the light source.

properties.name: LightIntensity
properties.description: Signed percentage intensity of the item's light source.

properties.name: LightSource
properties.description: Enables a map light source centered on this item.

properties.name: LightThru
properties.description: Allows map light propagation through every hex occupied by the item.

properties.name: MapId
properties.description: Identifier of the owning map while Ownership is MapHex; zero otherwise.

properties.name: MultihexGeneration
properties.description: Mapper coalescing strategy used to build MultihexMesh from compatible item placements.

properties.name: MultihexLines
properties.description: Direction and step-count pairs that trace additional footprint hexes from each mesh origin.

properties.name: MultihexMesh
properties.description: Explicit map hexes that share this item's footprint and optional repeated sprite.

properties.name: NoBlock
properties.description: Allows movement through every hex occupied by the item.

properties.name: NoHighlight
properties.description: Prevents the client from applying normal item highlight presentation.

properties.name: NoLightInfluence
properties.description: Prevents ambient map lighting from tinting the item's sprite.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Pixel offset applied to the item's map sprite from its origin hex.

properties.name: Ownership
properties.description: Current placement category: map hex, critter inventory, item container, or nowhere.

properties.name: PicInv
properties.description: Sprite resource used to present the item in inventory interfaces.

properties.name: PicMap
properties.description: Sprite resource used to render the item on a map.

properties.name: ShootThru
properties.description: Allows projectile traces through every hex occupied by the item.

properties.name: Stackable
properties.description: Allows equal items to merge into one entity whose Count is greater than one.

properties.name: Static
properties.description: Marks map-authored item data as static scenery rather than a dynamic item entity.

properties.name: StaticScript
properties.description: Server callback invoked when a critter interacts with this static item.

properties.name: TileLayer
properties.description: Zero-based ground- or roof-tile draw layer selected for a tile item.

properties.name: TriggerScript
properties.description: Server callback invoked when a critter enters or leaves this trigger item.

properties.name: CritterIds
properties.description: Persistent identifiers of the non-player critters owned by this map.

properties.name: CustomHolderEntry
properties.description: For a custom entity, names the holder entry through which it is attached.

properties.name: CustomHolderId
properties.description: For a custom entity, stores the persistent identifier of its owning holder; zero when the holder has no persistent identifier.

properties.name: DayColor
properties.description: Channel-major RGB values for the map's corresponding daylight color keyframes.

properties.name: DayColorTime
properties.description: Map-specific daylight color keyframe times expressed in minutes of the day cycle.

properties.name: ExplicitlyPersistent
properties.description: Marks an entity as independently persistent rather than persistent only through containment by another entity.

properties.name: FixedDayTime
properties.description: Map-local day-time override value, conventionally expressed in minutes and interpreted by game scripts.

properties.name: GlobalDayColor
properties.description: Current client-side global daylight color supplied through SetDayColors for scripts and effects.

properties.name: GlobalDayLightCapacity
properties.description: Current daylight capacity percentage for light sources flagged as global, clamped to 0 through 100.

properties.name: InitScript
properties.description: Server initialization function called after the map-init event for a newly created or restored map.

properties.name: ItemIds
properties.description: Persistent identifiers of the dynamic items placed directly on this map.

properties.name: LocId
properties.description: Identifier of the location that owns this map.

properties.name: LocMapIndex
properties.description: Zero-based position of this map in its owning location's map list.

properties.name: MapDayColor
properties.description: Current client-side map tint supplied through SetDayColors and consumed by map rendering.

properties.name: MapDayLightCapacity
properties.description: Current daylight capacity percentage for ordinary map light sources, clamped to 0 through 100.

properties.name: ScrollAxialArea
properties.description: Axial-coordinate rectangle that bounds map scrolling; a zero rectangle leaves the full map available.

properties.name: ScrollOffset
properties.description: Rounded client viewport offset in map-space pixels.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Width and height of the map grid in hexes.

properties.name: SpritesZoom
properties.description: Current client map-sprite zoom factor.

properties.name: SpritesZoomTarget
properties.description: Target zoom factor toward which the client map view is interpolating.

properties.name: WorkHex
properties.description: Authoring work hex used as the initial Mapper view center.
